corrections.text: The article quotes the Apache Fluss GitHub repository as describing Fluss as bridging "data streaming and data warehousing by enabling low-latency, high-throughput ingestion while integrating with Apache Flink and Spark." The repository's README actually says Fluss bridges "data streaming and data Lakehouse by enabling low-latency, high-throughput data ingestion and processing while seamlessly integrating with popular compute engines like Apache Flink and Apache Spark." The source says "Lakehouse," not "data warehousing."
